reason: A DSH interface plugin that enables dragging sessions between workspaces by cloning the full history into a new target session and archiving the original.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面中通过拖放将会话移动到其他工作区，并以完整历史克隆新会话后归档原会话。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness interface plugin that moves sessions between workspaces by cloning their complete history into a new session and archiving the original.

capabilities: Adds drag-and-drop session movement between workspaces in the DSH web interface
Creates and persists a new session with copied history in the target workspace
Attaches the new session to the target workspace and archives the source session
Registers a host API route for the move operation
